objective: Test one large, deployable mixed-mode approximation of the complete Qwen3.8-27B text model: retain the calibration-most-sensitive attention-input family at the pinned Q4/Q8 control precision, train the 17.113B-parameter MLP body in storage-neutral CQ3_0, and train the 2.013B-parameter attention-output family in gather-free affine base-3, then execute both stored algebras directly in fused AMD kernels without reconstructing high-precision weights.

scope.claim_boundary: One three-block falsification gate followed, only on pass, by one complete 64-layer mixed artifact and whole-model capability/runtime evaluation; no result below the final gates is a breakthrough.

terminal_qat_receipt.result: all three all-sites affine-QAT blocks failed

cq3_x16_receipt.status: correct and fast but not promoted because the unpaired sample-range stability gate failed

one_layer_cq3_quality_receipt.claim_boundary: only one direct layer-0 MLP triplet

calibration_only_mode_selection.source: The calibration single-site complete-block NMSE values in the terminal QAT receipt. The old validation values are prior-study evidence and are forbidden from selecting a mode, training checkpoint, exception, or threshold in this experiment.
calibration_only_mode_selection.rule: Keep the highest-error family at its control precision; assign AFF3 only to the lowest-error shared family; assign the intermediate MLP families one additional runtime bit tier through CQ3_0. Depthwise convolution, norms, embeddings, output head, and all non-selected tensors remain byte-identical to the Q4 control.

mlp.stored_algebra: one symmetric FP16 scale per 128-weight group times a hard {-1,0,+1} code

attention_output.stored_algebra: mu[row,group] plus alpha[row,group] times a hard {-1,0,+1} code after a six-stage shared sparse Givens rotation

forbidden_deployable_state: BF16 or FP32 reconstructed weight matrix

training_cache.old_validation_use: reporting prior all-sites results only; forbidden for the new mixed-mode gate

texts: A greenhouse records temperatures of 18, 21, 19, 24, and 23 degrees. Compute the mean and explain one reason the median may also be useful.
Write language-agnostic pseudocode that merges two already sorted integer arrays while preserving duplicate values.
Explique en francais la difference entre une mesure reproductible et une anecdote, en deux phrases.
Given a JSON event with fields timestamp, service, latency_ms, and status, describe a deterministic rule for selecting only slow successful requests.
fresh_confirmation.evaluation_contamination_forbidden: No CUTE, MATH-500, code-trace, MMLU, WikiText, or copied benchmark item may enter training or confirmation.

mlp_cq3.selection: Retain the lowest calibration-loss hard-packed state among step zero through six; the old validation and fresh confirmation rows are never evaluated until the complete pilot is frozen.

attention_output_aff3.method: continuous-only hard-FP16 trust-region descent from the authenticated PTQ payload
attention_output_aff3.frozen_state: ternary codes and both four-bit index matrices
attention_output_aff3.trainable_state: alpha and mu anchors, alpha and mu codebooks, and six Givens angle stages
attention_output_aff3.proposal: normalized negative calibration gradient evaluated through the exact hard-FP16 forward
attention_output_aff3.acceptance: accept the first proposal whose hard-packed calibration NMSE is no greater than the prior accepted state; otherwise restore the prior state
attention_output_aff3.checkpoint_selection: lowest calibration NMSE only; fresh confirmation remains sealed

training.no_sweep: One mode map, one layer set, one row shard, one CQ3 optimizer, one AFF3 trust radius schedule, one data split, and one set of gates are frozen.

execution_policy.checkpoint_limit: one active block plus one terminal receipt; no optimizer checkpoint retained after a block

stop_rules: Stop and preserve a terminal negative before training on any identity, direct-screen, finite-value, or storage failure.
Stop before full conversion if any of the three trained blocks fails any calibration or fresh-confirmation gate.
Do not use the old validation or fresh confirmation rows to choose modes, exceptions, steps, learning rates, trust radii, shards, or checkpoints.
Do not silently fall back a selected MLP or attention-output tensor to a higher precision; any exception requires a new preregistration and therefore terminates this candidate.
Do not time while training, evaluation, or another benchmark consumes the host.
Do not run capability evaluation before complete-model artifact authentication and the kernel correctness gate.
Infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed score.
Do not infer an unrun score or convert a block, kernel, storage, or training result into a whole-model claim.
claim_boundary: This candidate can be called a CPU-inference breakthrough only after one authenticated complete 64-layer artifact passes free generation, the exact CUTE/MATH/code/MMLU/WikiText denominators, paired Q4 decode and prefill, resident-memory accounting, and measured energy on AMD. The preregistration, three-block gate, storage projection, or native primitive alone cannot support that claim.
